title: MFP Effective Status Aggregation Record
description: Derived per-UniProt aggregation record for MFPB_0_13_EFFECTIVE_STATUS_CONTRACT_V0. Aggregates validated source claims into a single effective status per UniProt ID.

uniprot_id.description: UniProt accession string (grouping key). Empty for excluded records with blank/missing UniProt IDs.

effective_status.description: Highest-precedence operational status from grouped claims.

status_set.description: All distinct operational statuses in the group.

has_curated_claim.description: True if any claim in the group has status curated.

has_predicted_claim.description: True if any claim in the group has status predicted.

has_excluded_likely_claim.description: True if any claim in the group has status excluded_likely.

has_unresolved_claim.description: True if any claim in the group has status unresolved.

claim_count.description: Total number of claims in the group.

source_count.description: Number of distinct sources in the group.

aggregation_policy_id.description: Policy identifier for the aggregation (contract version).

transformation_id.description: Transformation identifier for the aggregation run.

record_status.description: Record status: valid for aggregated records, excluded for blank UniProt IDs.
